texts.value: Calcium-regulated non-lysosomal thiol-protease which catalyzes limited proteolysis of substrates involved in cytoskeletal remodeling and signal transduction. Proteolytically cleaves MYOC at 'Arg-226' (PubMed:17650508). Proteolytically cleaves CPEB3 following neuronal stimulation which abolishes CPEB3 translational repressor activity, leading to translation of CPEB3 target mRNAs (By similarity)
Activated by 200-1000 micromolar concentrations of calcium and inhibited by calpastatin

Forms a heterodimer with a small (regulatory) subunit (CAPNS1). Interacts with CPEB3; this leads to cleavage of CPEB3 (By similarity). Interacts with PIDD1 alternative open reading frame protein altPIDD1 (PubMed:39532532)
Translocates to the plasma membrane upon Ca(2+) binding
Ubiquitinated via 'Lys6'-linked chains by the E3 ubiquitin ligase complex at least composed of CUL3, KCTD7 and RBX1 to execute atypical, non-degradative ubiquitination
Belongs to the peptidase C2 family
